company.name: Memrythm Labs
company.shortDescription: Persistent runtime infrastructure for autonomous AI agents.
company.description:
Memrythm Labs is an AI infrastructure company building the runtime and state management layer for autonomous AI systems.

The company enables AI agents to operate inside persistent, reproducible, and forkable execution environments across filesystems, processes, browser sessions, databases, and memory contexts.

Its platform allows developers and enterprises to:

create isolated AI execution sandboxes
snapshot and restore agent environments
fork execution paths into parallel branches
replay and debug autonomous workflows
coordinate multiple AI agents across tools and models

Memrythm Labs is designed to sit above existing AI ecosystems such as Claude, Codex, Cursor, and other agent frameworks, providing reliability, observability, and execution continuity for production-grade AI automation.

The company is focused on powering the next generation of stateful autonomous systems and AI-native software infrastructure.
